job: Show how much of a limit is used.
purpose: A thin bar that shows use against a limit. Set data-value and data-max; the fill, the colour and the ARIA meter role follow. It turns warning from 80% and danger from 95%. Segmented meters split use by category and take colours from the chart palette. The figures are the real information; the bar is the glance.
useWhen: A quota, a credit balance or a rate limit has a cap.
A table cell shows use next to the number: use the inline variant.
Use splits across categories: use the segmented variant with a legend.

avoidWhen.when: A share of a whole with two to five parts.
A ranking of items by size.

states.name: warning
states.how: data-level="warning" from 80%; thresholds change with data-warn

states.name: danger
states.how: data-level="danger" from 95%; thresholds change with data-danger

variants.useWhen: Bar and figure on one line, for table cells.
Use split by category; add a legend with values.
A thinner bar in dense rows.
A thicker bar for a headline quota.
A bar in ink when the accent is spoken for.
Force green, for something that should be full.
A segment in the first chart colour.

parts.role: One category of a segmented meter.
The legend of a segmented meter.
